methodology.purpose: Supplemental curated discovery input for the expanded A-share MVP.
methodology.coverage_note: Curated, incomplete coverage. This expansion is not a claim of complete historical coverage.
methodology.multi_asset_mapping_note: Candidates may define asset_impacts so one event can generate multiple A-share asset-level observations.

candidates.event_name: Federal Reserve delivers emergency 50 bp rate cut
candidates.first_trigger_title: Federal Reserve issues FOMC statement
candidates.summary: The Federal Reserve cut the target range for the federal funds rate by 50 basis points during the COVID shock.
candidates.reasoning: Emergency easing can lower real-rate expectations and support safe-haven gold demand.
candidates.notes: Expansion candidate; source URL should be manually reviewed before production use.

candidates.reasoning: Large-scale liquidity support and crisis policy easing can support gold through safe-haven and monetary channels.
